NOTICE — body.glb and Three.js/Draco vendor files
===================================================

body.glb
  Anatomical 3D model derived from Z-Anatomy (https://www.z-anatomy.com/)
  Browser-ready GLB assembled by hpfrei/body-anatomy-3d-viewer
  (https://github.com/hpfrei/body-anatomy-3d-viewer)
  License: CC BY-SA 4.0

Three.js (three.module.js, OrbitControls.js, GLTFLoader.js, DRACOLoader.js)
  Copyright 2010-2023 Three.js Authors
  License: MIT  — https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/master/LICENSE

Draco (draco_decoder.js, draco_decoder.wasm, draco_wasm_wrapper.js)
  Copyright 2017 The Draco Authors
  License: Apache 2.0 — https://github.com/google/draco/blob/master/LICENSE

This project modifies the coloring and interaction scheme of the viewer
(muscle scoring, explode/peel animation, inspector sidebar).
Bones are hidden and do not participate in picking or animation.
